Specification: This module defines a simulation-oriented wrapper around an existing ccfraft specification, adding randomized guards to selected actions, custom initialization choices, a redefined fairness condition, periodic TLC statistics serialization, and a postcondition module for counterexample shortening. The fault model is not introduced independently here; instead, the module reuses the underlying ccfraft behavior and constrains simulation scheduling through RandomElement-based throttling and IO-environment parameters. The specification also includes utilities for stopping TLC after a time budget, serializing runtime data, and a postcondition that records the depth of a discovered counterexample so TLC can be rerun in simulation mode with progressively smaller bounds.
IfThenElse: IF "R" \in DOMAIN IOEnv THEN atoi(IOEnv.R) ELSE 10
IF "Q" \in DOMAIN IOEnv THEN atoi(IOEnv.Q) ELSE 10
IF "C" \in DOMAIN IOEnv THEN atoi(IOEnv.C) ELSE 10
IF "T" \in DOMAIN IOEnv THEN atoi(IOEnv.T) ELSE 1000
IF ("SIM_TIMEOUT" \in DOMAIN IOEnv) /\ IOEnv.SIM_TIMEOUT # "" THEN atoi(IOEnv.SIM_TIMEOUT) ELSE 1200

IF CounterExample.state = {} THEN TRUE ELSE /\ PrintT("Length of counterexample: " \o ToString(Cardinality(CounterExample.state))) /\ Serialize(ToString(Cardinality(CounterExample.state) - 1), "depth.txt", [format |-> "TXT", charset |-> "UTF-8", openOptions |-> <<"WRITE", "CREATE", "TRUNCATE_EXISTING">>]).exitValue = 0
FairnessConditions: \A s \in Servers : \E newConfiguration \in SUBSET(Servers) \ {{}}: WF_vars(CCF!ChangeConfigurationInt(s, newConfiguration))
